request: What is the return window for Juniper Home Goods?
initial_prediction: If you return it to the store its 14 days, otherwise you can return it via Cartwheel within 30 days
policy_clarification: Juniper Home Goods has a 14-day return window for all Juniper orders. The Juniper rule overrides Cartwheel's 30-day default regardless of return route.
expected_from_real_policy: The agent should answer 14 days from delivery for all Juniper Home Goods orders, explain that the store rule overrides the 30-day Cartwheel default, and identify the policy source.
cli_command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/cartwheel-uv-cache uv run python -m agent.cli --role shopper --user 1 --model openrouter --debug
approval: User explicitly approved sending this policy test, including the agent instructions and retrieved demo policies, to OpenRouter.

results.title: Juniper Home Goods store policy
results.snippet:
# Juniper Home Goods store policy

Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within 14 days of delivery, instead of the Cartwheel platform default of 30 days. This store window takes precedence for all Juniper Home Goods orders.

results.title: Cartwheel return policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides polic

results.title: Cascade Audio store policy
results.snippet:
# Cascade Audio store policy

Cascade Audio follows the Cartwheel platform return window of 30 days from delivery. Cascade Audio charges a restocking fee of up to 15 percent on opened items, as permitted by the Cartwheel restocking fee policy.
